loc-fb127ec305.read: Tough one for Kingsley. The Stags' season ended Saturday in the Division 6 state semifinal in Clare, 30-6 against Almont. Kingsley actually scored on its first drive, then Almont ran off 30 straight. The Stags finish 12-1 with a regional title, so give those seniors a big Up North thank-you. Almont plays Lumen Christi for the title Friday at Ford Field.
loc-fb127ec305.what: 30-6 loss in the D6 state semifinal; season ends 12-1
loc-fb127ec305.why: Twelve straight wins, a regional title and a town that followed them down US-127

loc-b90f641339.read: Michigan pulled off the upset of the weekend. They beat No. 4 UCLA 18-16 in triple overtime at the Big House, and it ended on Bryce Underwood's two-point pass to Jalen Hoffman. That's UCLA's first loss, and Michigan is now 6-5 and bowl-eligible. Ohio State is next Saturday.
loc-b90f641339.what: 18-16 win in triple overtime; UCLA's first loss
loc-b90f641339.why: Michigan becomes bowl-eligible heading into Ohio State week

loc-bdd1cd5f00.read: If you want Christmas lights without leaving your heated car, Alpenlights is open at the Otsego County Fairgrounds in Gaylord. It's a drive-through show with more than 50 props synced to music, priced per car: $15 on Sunday, $20 Wednesday and Thursday, $25 Friday and Saturday. And the owner told UpNorthLive he hopes to add a Traverse City location next year.
loc-bdd1cd5f00.what: Drive-through holiday light show open for the season
loc-bdd1cd5f00.when: Now through the season; Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun nights
loc-bdd1cd5f00.why: Easy family holiday outing, with a possible TC location next year
